# DMG layout dependencies

Vendored, unmodified Python source for offline release packaging only.
Both packages use the MIT license; license texts are included here.
`ds_store` depends only on `mac_alias`; `mac_alias` has no package dependencies.
Neither is bundled in the application or disk image.
